summary: Silexion Therapeutics Corp filed an 8-K to disclose warrant adjustments following a previously announced 1-for-10 reverse share split. The adjustments reduce the number of ordinary shares issuable per warrant to 1/10th of a share and increase the exercise price tenfold to $15,525.00 per post-split share. The warrant terms are governed by a Warrant Agreement dated February 19, 2021, assigned to the company in connection with a business combination completed August 15, 2024. No fractional shares will be issued; rounding up to the nearest whole share applies. This is a routine corporate action, not a special situation.
